title: Create stocktake session with scope, operators, dates, snapshot
objective: Verify POST /stocktakes creates a session with name, location scope, assigned operators, start/due dates, and captures a snapshot (snapshot_at) of in-scope assets.
preconditions: Manager session (create permission); seeded locations with assets.
test_data: session {name 'Q3 HQ Count', locations [HQ], operators [operator], start today, due +14d}
steps: GET /stocktakes/<uuid>; verify fields and snapshot timestamp.
Verify operator (non-manager) cannot create a session (403).
expected_result: 201 with session UUID; snapshot_at recorded; in-scope asset set deterministically derived from locations; creation audited; role gating per route table (Manager create, Operator count).

title: Record observations — scanned and manual with outcome classification
objective: Verify POST /stocktakes/:uuid/observations records time, operator, location, condition, note/image, and classifies outcomes: found, not-found, unexpected, duplicate-scan, moved, condition-mismatch.
preconditions: Started session over HQ; assets: A-in-scope at HQ, B-in-scope moved to other room, C-out-of-scope (unexpected), asset with different recorded condition.
test_data: observations: scan A (found), scan A again (duplicate-scan), scan B at HQ (moved), scan C (unexpected), observe condition change on A variant (condition-mismatch), manual entry for missing tag
steps: Start the session (POST start) if required by contract.
Submit each observation; record returned outcome classification.
Submit observation with unknown tag → verify handling (asset nullable, tag_scanned retained).
expected_result: Each observation classified per spec rules; duplicates detected per session+asset; unknown tags recorded non-destructively; observations idempotent via Idempotency-Key on retry; all observations timestamped with operator identity.

title: Stocktake authorization — assigned operators count, others denied
objective: Verify only assigned operators (within scope) can submit observations; session visible per role/scope; auditors read-only.
preconditions: Active session with assigned operator O1; unassigned operator O2; employee; auditor.
steps: Read session as auditor → read-only success; mutation attempt → 403.
expected_result: Role/scope enforcement per design; no existence leaks across scopes; denials audited if documented.

title: Variance report and close require permission + final report
objective: Verify GET /stocktakes/:uuid/variance summarizes found/not-found/unexpected/moved/condition-mismatch counts vs snapshot, and closing a session requires the close permission and produces a final variance report.
preconditions: Session with recorded observations covering multiple outcome classes.
test_data: variance expectations computed from seeded observations
steps: GET variance; reconcile counts against submitted observations + snapshot.
Attempt close as operator (no close permission) → expect 403.
Close as manager; verify final report generated and session immutable afterward.
expected_result: Variance counts reconcile exactly with ground truth; close gated by permission; post-close mutations (new observations) rejected with stable error; close audited with actor/timestamp; final report accessible to authorized users.

title: Mobile count UI — usable at 320–480px, connectivity-loss honesty
objective: Verify /stocktakes/[id]/count works on a phone viewport (large touch targets, no horizontal scroll) and that connectivity loss shows honest retry UX with no false 'saved' claims (layout §15.3).
preconditions: Playwright with mobile viewport emulation; active session; operator signed in.
steps: Open count page at 360px; record an observation via manual entry; verify success feedback only after server confirm.
Simulate offline; attempt another observation; verify queued/retry or clear failure messaging (no false saved).
Restore connectivity; verify recovery path per documented behavior.
expected_result: Count UI fully operable at small viewport (≥44px targets, no h-scroll); offline attempts never claim success; on reconnect user can retry without duplicates (idempotency key reuse); offline stocktake beyond this is out of scope (D-03) and not falsely implied.

title: E2E Journey J-3 — perform a stocktake (execution slice)
objective: UI journey: manager creates session, operator counts assets (found + one unexpected), manager reviews variance and closes.
preconditions: Full stack seeded; Playwright; manager + operator credentials.
test_data: new session over one small location; 3 in-scope assets; 1 unexpected tag
steps: As manager: create session via /stocktakes wizard; start it.
As operator: open count page; submit found scans for 2 assets + 1 unexpected tag.
As manager: open session; review variance summary; close session.
Verify final report visible and session read-only.
expected_result: Journey completes with UI states matching API truth at each step; variance numbers correct; close produces final report; evidence screenshots captured. (Reconciliation-driven master-data updates may be Cycle-3 polish — record actual behavior, do not force.)
